title: Rabbi Yochanan ben Elazar
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Pesachim 51a, Rabbah bar bar Chanah said, “Rabbi Yochanan ben Elazar told me: once I entered after Rabbi Shimon, son of Rabbi Yose ben Lakunya,” etc. Shabbat 49b reads Rabbi Yonatan.

notes.text: The consulted Pesachim paragraph explicitly names Rabbah bar bar Chanah. The previous expansion of רבב״ח as Bivi bar Abaye is withdrawn; the unquoted continuation is not inserted.
In the consulted Pesachim passage Yohanan ben Elazar enters after Shimon. Shabbat 49b has Yonatan beRabbi Elazar reporting Shimon in a differently framed passage.
